response: The biomolecular identification of allergenic pollen presents a new perspective for aerobiological monitoring. Recent studies have shown that real-time PCR approaches can effectively identify and quantify pollen, even in mixed samples. This method has revealed promising results and could potentially be developed further into multiplex real-time PCR for the simultaneous detection of different taxa in a single reaction tube. Additionally, the application of high-throughput molecular methods may also be explored in the future. This new perspective could enhance the accuracy and efficiency of aerobiological monitoring, ultimately contributing to better management and prevention of pollen-related allergies.
